description: Write SEO metadata into a JPEG, PNG or WebP image and return the modified image. The picture is never re-encoded and existing metadata of the same kind is replaced, not duplicated. Paid per successful call over x402: the first attempt answers HTTP 402 with the price; a failed call is not charged.

alt.description: What a reader who cannot see it needs told. Different from the description — not a copy of it.

copyright.description: For example: (c) 2026 Your Name. All rights reserved.

description.description: What the picture shows, for a reader who can already see it.

image_base64.description: The image, base64 encoded. JPEG, PNG or WebP.

keywords.description: Comma separated. Each becomes its own entry.

title.description: A short name for the image, not a sentence.

name: write_metadata
